title: Putaway Rule
description: Defines the ordered sequence of zones in which to look for a free storage place for an incoming load unit, and how to choose a place within each zone, for a given item/category scope. Inbound counterpart of search_rule. Does not itself reserve or book any storage_point - see README 'What this repo is not'.

applies_to.description: Scopes this rule to an item, an owner and/or a category - see applies-to.schema.json for the allowed combinations and the precedence. Omit entirely for this building's default/fallback rule; at most one putaway_rule per building may omit it, see tools/validate.py.

steps.description: Ordered zone sequence: step 1 is tried first, later steps are fallbacks only consulted if earlier steps have no suitable free place. A step that names load_unit_types is skipped for any other load unit type - the step order therefore also ranks which zones a load unit type prefers (OpenWMS TypePlacingRule.privilege_level).

load_unit_types.description: Topology-as-Code load_unit_type ids this step applies to. Omitted = every load unit type the zone itself allows.

allow_mixed_items.description: Whether a storage place may hold stock of more than one item. Must not contradict the zone's Topology-as-Code homogeneity_required (cross-repo check not yet implemented).

allow_mixed_owners.description: Whether a storage place may hold stock of more than one owner. Only meaningful in multi-owner warehouses (MasterData-as-Code company.yaml owners).

allow_mixed_lots.description: Whether a storage place may hold more than one lot of the same item. Only meaningful for lot-managed items.

max_fill_percent.description: Stop placing into this zone once its occupancy reaches this share, keeping capacity in reserve (OpenWMS LocationGroup max fill level).
